I answered Hollis in a thread on their #central-random message: the ticket is **#88412**.

I found it in #central-team, a channel Hollis is in. Tobias raised it there on 2 Jul 2025 as a Tier 2 escalation: the Door 6 gatehouse tablet froze on the BOL barcode scan, and the night shift lead said it happened when Quarendon Freightways drivers arrived with split manifests. In the same conversation Tobias confirmed the ticket was for Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel. There are no Tansleigh files in the share, so that message is the only source.
